supersedes: R3 decoder PATH policy, public capabilities and static media extensions; provider changes remain R3 baseline pending coordination merge

private_manifest_contract.value: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters calculated from the installed ffprobe.exe bytes; no hash invented here
private_manifest_contract.extra_fields: permitted for license, official download URL and verification receipt; no executable path override accepted

dependency_policy: Fixed vendor/ffmpeg/ffprobe.exe only. Missing/invalid manifest or executable mismatch fails closed. No PATH fallback. Every capability read hashes current executable. Actual execution copies and hashes identical bytes into a new temporary snapshot, validates hash, then launches snapshot without shell; source swap after copy cannot change executable snapshot. Manifest integrity itself belongs to coordinator deployment custody and permissions; replacing both executable and manifest is not prevented by a self-contained hash check.
readiness: audio=True and audio_formats=['wav'] without external dependency. Verified decoder adds mp3/flac/ogg/m4a and video formats mp4/mov/avi/wmv. Readiness describes validator availability, not consent, guaranteed decoding of every codec variant, successful execution of a provider request or browser playback support. Actual probe errors remain visible refusals.
host_integration: from iald_mimo_multimodal import media_capabilities; compute caps=media_capabilities() on host before advertising.

For eligible consented MiMo, compose provider limits with audio=caps['audio'],video=caps['video'],media_capabilities=caps. For other providers or missing consent2 set audio/video false. Do not let caps bypass authorization.
Auto owner follows same MiMo eligibility and consent2 rules. JEV receives only metadata projection; attachment bytes remain outside router payload.

Client reads limitesDoPlano().media_capabilities.audio_formats/video_formats and outer audio/video flags. Formats are extension identifiers, not MIME strings. Missing capability object yields no media picker extensions and rejects local media.

Use iald_routing_metrics.stamp for provider metric lifecycle per coordination interface; replace R3 metric_task call sites when merging. This R4 deliberately does not edit providers, router, task_policy or webserver.
Install decoder and license through coordinator plan only, with verified receipt and manifest. No binary downloaded or installed by this front.
context_notice: Client explicitly states 512KB is local media limit, and even smaller input may exceed conversation context; TGL memory is preserved and request refused. No scientific memory, history or input reduction introduced by this round.

validation.initial_dependency_test_attempt: Windows sandbox denied default temporary directory writes; tests rerun in staging temporary directories and passed

limits: Current fixed media512000 bytes, WAV30s and video10s retained. No claim of full 50MB vendor input admission. Structured output/helper and image pipeline remain under prior integration review. Python execution is separate; no native MiMo image/video generation asserted.
